channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: President Murmu to visit Jaipur today; traffic diversions announced
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu will arrive in Jaipur on Friday on a daylong visit to Rajasthan, during which she will participate in the '1008 Kundiya Hanuman Mahayagya' at the Neendar Housing Scheme, Harmada (Sikar Road).

item.title: Rights group alleges killing of 15 minority Hindus in Bangladesh in 45 days
item.description: A New Delhi-based rights group, the Rights and Risks Analysis Group (RRAG), has claimed that at least 15 members of the Hindu minority community were killed in Bangladesh over the past 45 days, allegedly by individuals belonging to the Muslim majority.

item.title: Odisha: Internet curbed, schools shut after communal violence in Sundargarh
item.description: Tension erupted on Thursday in Sundargarh district of Odisha after rumours reportedly emerged over the alleged sale of beef at a meat shop in Regent Market under the Sundargarh Town Police limits.

item.title: BJP Alliance Takes Early Lead in Mumbai BMC Elections
item.description: The BJP-led alliance has taken an early lead in the high-stakes Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) elections, according to initial trends, as counting of votes began on Friday for civic body polls across Maharashtra.

item.title: Mother of Elon Musk’s child sues xAI over her explicit images
item.description: Ashley St. Clair, an American author and the mother of one of Elon Musk’s children, has filed a lawsuit against Musk’s AI company xAI, alleging its chatbot Grok generated sexually explicit images of her without consent.

item.title: Supreme Court rejects Justice Varma’s plea challenging impeachment proceedings over cash discovery allegations
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday rejected a plea filed by Allahabad High Court Justice Yashwant Varma -- who faces impeachment proceedings following the cash-discovery row -- challenging the decision of the Lok Sabha Speaker to constitute a three-member inquiry committee against him under the Judges (Inquiry) Act, 1968.

item.title: Weatherman predicts heavy snowfall in J&K between Jan 20-24
item.description: The minimum temperature showed improvement across Jammu and Kashmir on Friday, attributed to a night of continuous cloud cover.

item.title: Congress seeks clarification after its leader ‘abused’ woman Municipal Commissioner in Karnataka
item.description: Meanwhile, the District Government Employees' Association has organised a protest demanding the arrest of Gowda. The silence of the Minister for Municipal Administration and Haj Rahim Khan is also being questioned.

item.title: Govt extends export incentives to postal shipments to boost MSME sector
item.description: In a bid to strengthen India’s e-commerce and MSME sectors, the government on Friday said it has extended export incentives to postal shipments, with effect from January 15.

item.title: ‘EC gaslighting citizens’: Rahul Gandhi attacks poll panel over ink row; BJP hits back
item.description: Rahul Gandhi, the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, launched a pointed criticism of the Election Commission of India, accusing the ECI of undermining public confidence in democracy by 'facilitating' vote theft -- a claim that the Congress party has persistently made for some time in an effort to discredit the poll panel.
